hyps.why: Replacing a useful skip shortcut yields a smaller gain than filling an empty edge.
Restoring a missing input edge gives a large gain.
Filling a missing output edge gives a large gain.
A strong direct path already exists so the extra conv is redundant.
A skip on 1->2 passes the conv features from edge 0 onward.
Capacity is already saturated by a strong direct conv.
Adding a shortcut where the direct edge was missing is a big gain.
Downgrading a strong conv to pooling loses more accuracy.
Removing a strong conv on the input edge hurts more than removing a weak op.
Edge 0 conv makes 0->1->3 a deep conv path that the edit completes.
